description: PhishTank is a collaborative clearing house for phishing URL verification. Developers can check URLs against a community-maintained phishing database and consume data feeds for mail and browser protection.
resolution_notes: base_url: ORIGINAL kept — official docs (phishtank.com/api_info.php) document POST endpoint path /checkurl/ under host https://checkurl.phishtank.com; base host without path is correct directory convention (Verifier A incorrectly folded path into base_url). rate_limits: ORIGINAL "not published" confirmed — API docs state registered keys get higher limits but publish no numeric quotas; Verifier B's historical ~10/min is unconfirmed anecdote, not current published limit.
